description: RLUSD monthly reserve report history and exact third-party attestation periods need period-level records before SOG displays a historical reserve timeline.

description: RLUSD XRP Ledger issuer/token identifiers and Ethereum contract address need official docs, implementation, or verified explorer sources before final address display.
notes: PR-028A keeps XRP Ledger and Ethereum deployment rows as issuer-supported source-review areas.

description: EURC monthly reserve or attestation report history needs exact period-level report URLs before SOG displays a historical reserve timeline.

description: EURC conversion through Circle Mint, account eligibility, business access, geography, and retail availability need source-specific explanation.

description: USDP reserve report archive entries need period-level report rows before SOG displays a historical reserve timeline.

description: USDP Solana token status, issuer support level, and exact lifecycle context should be reviewed against Paxos sources and explorer data before being treated as final chain coverage.

description: USDG reserve report source and period-level reserve reporting history need exact source-backed entries before SOG displays a reserve timeline.
notes: PR-028D added network and Paxos reserve entry points only.

description: Direct one-to-one redemption is limited to verified Paxos customers and may be routed through Paxos Digital Singapore or Paxos Issuance Europe. Exact availability by residence, registered Paxos entity, account state, current minimum schedule, and banking route remains variable under the current terms.
notes: Keep direct Paxos redemption separate from Global Dollar Network participation, partner access, wallet holding, and exchange liquidity.

description: USDG supported chains, canonical contract addresses, and issuer-supported deployment status need official source review before final chain coverage is displayed.
notes: PR-028D keeps deployment as source_review_needed until durable docs are separated.

description: Global Dollar Network partner roles, partner incentives, public partner list, and network economics need source-specific documentation before they are modeled as stablecoin lifecycle facts.
notes: Partner/network information belongs in context fields, not as a safety or quality score.

description: The exact lifecycle relationship between DAI and USDS, including upgrade, conversion, reversibility, app flow, and any future migration changes, needs source-specific protocol documentation before final lifecycle treatment.
notes: PR-028E separates DAI/USDS lifecycle from savings-token context.

description: sUSDS is a related savings token and should not be merged into the USDS stablecoin record. Exact mint, withdrawal, rate, liquidity, and contract behavior need dedicated source-backed treatment.
notes: PR-028E records sUSDS as related context rather than as the same asset.

description: USDS collateral composition, protocol exposure, reserve-style reporting, and how these relate to legacy MakerDAO or current Sky disclosures need exact protocol and dashboard sources.
notes: A fiat-reserve framing is not appropriate for USDS without protocol-specific context.

description: Sky Savings Rate and related rates can change through protocol governance. Current rates, governing modules, and effective dates should not be represented as static guaranteed product terms.
notes: PR-028E keeps rate context separate from stablecoin status and avoids yield guarantees.

description: USDS, sUSDS, stUSDS, bridge, and chain-by-chain contract references need exact developer-doc, chainlog, or verified explorer sources before final addresses are displayed.
notes: PR-028E added documentation entry points but not final contract records.

description: Sky.money interface access, regional availability, USDS product availability, and protocol access should be separated because interface restrictions do not necessarily equal protocol unavailability.
notes: Keep interface access, protocol access, and secondary-market availability distinct.
